refreshToken.description:
When `true`, requests a proactive token refresh before returning.

In managed auth mode this triggers the normal refresh-token flow. In external auth mode this flag is ignored. Clients should refresh tokens themselves and call `account/login/start` with `chatgptAuthTokens`.

skipWorkspaceRouting.description: When `true`, returns the account as the server already knows it, without waiting for workspace routing discovery, which needs the network and can take many seconds. `workspaceRouting` is then `null`. The server keeps discovering in the background and sends `account/updated` once routing is known.
